pair_ordering_policy.principle: all substantive features are invariant to swapping the two people in an unordered pair
pair_ordering_policy.individual_dynamic_symmetrization: for each per-person scalar x1,x2 emit arithmetic mean and maximum
pair_ordering_policy.directional_cross_progression_symmetriza: for each mover emit arithmetic mean and maximum of A_to_B and B_to_A natal-target activation
pair_ordering_policy.progressed_to_progressed_symmetrization: for each mover emit only the maximum of the two directions
forbidden: using lower ADB id as a scientific A/B direction
separate fitted coefficients for arbitrary person-A vs person-B labels

annual_anchors.times: 12:00:00 on day 1 and day 15 of each month

note_on_planetary_sha256: The planetary_sha256 field above must be validated against the repository's pinned ephemeris manifest before feature generation. Any mismatch is a hard audit failure; do not silently repair the registry during a model run.

human_design.natal_design_root: exact moment when natal Sun longitude minus design Sun longitude modulo 360 equals 88 degrees
human_design.transit_overlay_rule: current geocentric planetary gates once each; no 88-day-prior transit Design chart
human_design.south_node_rule: gate opposite current true North Node gate

static_connection_classification.companionship: channel complete in both natal charts
static_connection_classification.dominance: channel complete in one natal chart and neither channel gate present in the other
static_connection_classification.compromise: channel complete in one natal chart and exactly one channel gate present in the other
static_connection_classification.electromagnetic: neither natal chart has full channel and the two people supply complementary single gates

M1_WESTERN_INDIVIDUAL.feature_template: for each of transit_Jupiter, transit_Saturn, transit_Uranus, transit_Neptune, transit_Pluto, progressed_Sun, progressed_Moon, progressed_Mercury, progressed_Venus, progressed_Mars emit own_activation_pair_mean and own_activation_pair_max

static_western_group_rules.m2w_static_luminary_activation: maximum major-aspect kernel across cross-person Sun/Moon combinations
static_western_group_rules.m2w_static_attraction_activation: maximum major-aspect kernel across cross-person Venus/Mars combinations
static_western_group_rules.m2w_static_communication_activation: maximum major-aspect kernel for Mercury to partner Sun/Moon/Mercury in both directions
static_western_group_rules.m2w_static_angle_activation: maximum major-aspect kernel for Sun/Moon/Mercury/Venus/Mars to partner ASC/MC in both directions

dynamic_western_rules.own_activation: at each anchor, mover to any own natal_target_set target; max over targets and aspects; annual max over anchors
dynamic_western_rules.progressed_to_partner_natal: per progressed mover, compute both directions to any partner natal_target_set target; annual max per direction; emit pair mean and pair max
dynamic_western_rules.progressed_to_partner_progressed_mutual: per mover, at each anchor compute mover of each person to any progressed Sun/Moon/Mercury/Venus/Mars target of the other; take max of directions, then annual max
dynamic_western_rules.transit_to_natal_midpoint_composite: per slow transit mover to any frozen natal midpoint-composite target; max targets/aspects at anchor; annual max
dynamic_western_rules.transit_to_progressed_midpoint_composite: per slow transit mover to any frozen progressed midpoint-composite target; max targets/aspects at anchor; annual max

dynamic_hd_rules.natal_person_gates: union Personality and exact-88-degree Design activations for natal_bodies
dynamic_hd_rules.transit_gates: current transit_gate_bodies at each anchor using true node plus exact opposites for Earth and South Node
dynamic_hd_rules.individual_new_channels: count channels in natal+transit overlay absent from natal fingerprint
dynamic_hd_rules.individual_new_centers: count defined Centers in natal+transit overlay absent from natal fingerprint
dynamic_hd_rules.pair_added_channels: count channels in pair+transit overlay absent from static pair fingerprint
dynamic_hd_rules.pair_added_centers: count defined Centers in pair+transit overlay absent from static pair fingerprint
dynamic_hd_rules.pair_split_bridge_reduction: max(0, static pair Definition component count - overlay Definition component count)

missingness_and_constants.constant_column_policy: retain registry column but standardize to zero; do not drop selectively based on outcome/model performance

forbidden_before_first_fit: adding or removing features after inspecting outcome-model performance
feature-specific coefficient mining to redefine a family
